name: gamma_rgb
source: var w=new Window(),p=new Layer(w,null),l=new Layer(w,p);l.setImageSize(32,1);for(var x=0;x<32;x++){l.setMainPixel(x,0,(((x*71)%256)<<16)|(((x*31)%256)<<8)|((x*151)%256));l.setMaskPixel(x,0,(x*53)%256);} l.face=1;l.imageModified=false;l.adjustGamma(2,10,240,0.6,20,220,1.3,-10,290);l.setClip(0,0,32,1);var a=[];for(var x=0;x<32;x++)a.add(l.getMainPixel(x,0)+":"+l.getMaskPixel(x,0));return a.join(",")+":"+l.imageModified;
